[P2] Require coverage for the guardrail configuration branch

No added test configures `BedrockConfig.guardrail`. The `guardrail_intervened` tests fabricate responses, so deleting this branch leaves their assertions unchanged while removing the caller's guardrail from requests. This violates CONTRIBUTING rule 4. Return to the design phase and retain this option only with coverage requiring the configured identifier and version to reach Converse, or remove it from the initial API.
